implementation.capability: Persistent headless worker process for ingest, RCP batch ingest, structural recognition, cleanup, and cloud export
durability: SQLite job payload migration is additive for existing databases
atomic worker claims use expiring leases and attempts are recorded
worker heartbeats renew leases; expired leases can be reclaimed
external cancellation is persisted and checked at progress checkpoints
API startup recovery preserves queued/running worker-owned imports
RCP batch imports retain per-station failures and resumable ingest checkpoints

acceptance_evidence.separate_process_integration: The `test_worker_process.py` integration starts real worker subprocesses for synthetic PLY ingest, structural recognition, voxel cleanup to a derived cloud, and verified PLY export; the jobs succeed and the exported file is downloadable. The production database and FARO sources were not used.
acceptance_evidence.focused_current_regression: All 6 tests in backend/tests/test_worker_process.py passed with the tmpdir plugin disabled. Coverage includes separate-process ingest and recognition, ingest → voxel cleanup → verified export/download, API startup recovery, exclusive claim and lease reclaim, persisted queued cancellation, and additive SQLite schema migration. Test inputs and databases were isolated under S2B_DATA_DIR.
acceptance_evidence.full_backend_suite_after_extension: All 808 backend tests passed (0 failed; 1 existing Starlette/httpx deprecation warning) after recognition, cleanup, and export handlers were added. The suite used an isolated S2B_DATA_DIR and a temporary pytest tmp_path fixture rooted inside it because Windows denied the default pytest temporary directory. In an earlier attempt, an overly long test root and an AutoCAD Core Console 20-second timeout under load were corrected by shortening the isolated root and rerunning the converter test; the complete suite then passed.
acceptance_evidence.legacy_database_migration: A database with the prior jobs schema received the new task, lease, attempt and cancellation columns without rebuilding the jobs table.

limitations: The queue uses SQLite and is suitable for workers sharing one host and data directory; it is not a multi-host corporate broker or shared PostgreSQL deployment.
Ingestion, RCP batch ingestion, structural recognition, cleanup, and cloud export have serializable handlers. Other CPU/GPU analysis tasks still use the API process executor.
CUDA execution remains unverified because compatible NVIDIA hardware is unavailable on this workstation.

data_safety.test_input: synthetic PLY in an isolated temporary directory
